title: Mass lower bound for lattice chains (Simon 6.1 (1))
statement: Let m, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, β : LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) N → ℝ (real coefficients of the faces F = ρ(z + F_α) ∈ 𝓛_{m+1}(ρ) of ℝ^N), and Pc ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^N) with Pc(ω) = Σ'_F β_F [[F]](ω) for every test form ω (IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc). Then for every face index F, |β_F| · ρ^{m+1} ≤ M(Pc) (stated in [0, ∞] as ENNReal.ofReal(|β_F| ρ^{m+1}) ≤ Pc.mass).
lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (β : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) N → ℝ) (Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) (m + 1)), 0 < ρ → IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc → ∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) N, ENNReal.ofReal (|β F| * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ Pc.mass
